project_type: Greenfield C# BDD test automation template (UI + API + E2E). Six projects: src/QAAutomation.Core, src/QAAutomation.UI, src/QAAutomation.Api, tests/QAAutomation.Tests.UI, tests/QAAutomation.Tests.Api, tests/QAAutomation.Tests.E2E. The workspace currently holds only .vscode/, .kiro/ and .agents/ - every source file is new.
build_system: dotnet SDK with NuGet Central Package Management. ONE Directory.Packages.props at d:\git\QAAutomation sets ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true and CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled=true; every PackageReference in every .csproj is written with NO Version attribute (a Version attribute causes NU1008). Directory.Build.props sets net10.0, ImplicitUsings=disable (the SDK implicit set includes System.Linq, which would silently re-enable the banned construct), Nullable=disable, TreatWarningsAsErrors=false, EnforceCodeStyleInBuild=true, IsPackable=false. Directory.Build.targets carries a WarnOnLinqUsage target that findstrs hand-written @(Compile) files for 'using System.Linq' and emits an MSBuild Warning - a warning only, it must never fail the build.
test_framework: Reqnroll 3.3.4 with Reqnroll.NUnit on NUnit 4.6.1, NUnit3TestAdapter 6.3.0, Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 18.10.1, VSTest (the default - do NOT opt into Microsoft.Testing.Platform, because tag filtering relies on VSTest --filter semantics). DI through Reqnroll.Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection 3.3.4 via a static [ScenarioDependencies] factory per test project. Assertions with AwesomeAssertions 9.6.0 only - FluentAssertions 8+ is a licence liability and must never be added.
verification_instructions: 1. dotnet restore d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln - must succeed with no NU1008, no NU1605 and no version-conflict error. 2. dotnet build d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln - must report 'Build succeeded', 0 Warning(s), 0 Error(s). 3. Per suite: dotnet test d:\git\QAAutomation\tests\QAAutomation.Tests.Api, then ...Tests.UI, then ...Tests.E2E. 4. Whole solution: dotnet test d:\git\QAAutomation\QAAutomation.sln - expect 17 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (8 API, 8 UI, 1 E2E) on the planned scenario set. 5. Tag filtering: dotnet test <project> --filter "TestCategory=smoke". 6. After any UI run: Get-Process chromedriver -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue must return nothing, proving teardown quit the driver. 7. The no-LINQ signal: temporarily add 'using System.Linq;' to one source file, rebuild, confirm exactly one 'LINQ is banned' warning with 'Build succeeded' and 0 Error(s), then remove the line and rebuild back to 0 warnings. 8. UI failure artefacts: force one UI assertion to fail and confirm d:\git\QAAutomation\test-results\<suite>\<scenario>-<timestamp>\ contains screenshot.png, page-source.html, console.log and location.txt; then restore the assertion.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Reqnroll's generator emits *.feature.cs into obj/ at build time - never commit or hand-edit those, and .editorconfig marks *.feature.cs as generated_code=true. Refit 16.3.0 source-generates its client implementations at build time. test-results/ is runtime output and is gitignored. No approved-snapshot files exist (Reqnroll.Verify is reserved, not activated).
environment_constraints: Windows, PowerShell (Windows PowerShell 5.1; pwsh/PowerShell 7 is NOT installed). d:\git\QAAutomation is NOT a git repository: never run git init, never create a worktree, never commit, never push. .NET SDKs 10.0.301 and 8.0.425 are installed; target net10.0. Google Chrome must be present; Selenium Manager (built into Selenium 4.6+) resolves and downloads the matching driver on first run, so there is NO driver install step and NO driver package. Run UI headless with 1-2 workers. The system under test is a THIRD-PARTY PRODUCTION WEBSITE - every request must be read-only, request volume must stay low, and the contact form must never be submitted.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering is binding. code-style.md: no LINQ anywhere (query syntax, chained extension methods, Any/All/Count(predicate), FirstOrDefault, OrderBy, Select, or 'using System.Linq' in a new file) - write foreach loops with named locals; only three exceptions, namely a single-comparison AwesomeAssertions predicate, a lambda a library accepts nothing else for (WebDriverWait.Until, Refit ConfigureHttpClient), and one .ToList()/.ToArray() at a boundary. Explicit types, var only for a new of that exact type. No ternaries in steps, no a?.b?.c chains, guard clauses with max nesting depth two, named consts not magic strings, no reflection or dynamic, regex only as a last resort, shallow inheritance (one level max), methods around 20 lines, full words not abbreviations, DAMP over DRY (extract on the third occurrence). UI page objects are SYNCHRONOUS (Selenium's C# API is synchronous) with no *Async suffix; API clients and the steps that call them are async Task with *Async; .Result, .Wait(), .GetAwaiter().GetResult() and async void are banned. project-structure.md: dependency direction is one-way tests/* -> src/* -> Core, and no test project references another test project; NO pipelines/ folder; no Thread.Sleep in UI code - every wait goes through the ONE shared ElementWaits helper in Core/Utilities; one assertion concern per scenario and assertions live in steps only, never in page objects or clients. tech-stack.md: never add a package without a pin in Directory.Packages.props, and never add Selenium.WebDriver.ChromeDriver, WebDriverManager, DotNetSeleniumExtras.WaitHelpers or FluentAssertions. Security: no real key, token or connection string in any committed file - use YOUR_API_KEY_HERE placeholders and QAAUTOMATION_* environment variables; never log an Authorization header, cookie or unmasked PII.
key_patterns: Hooks and the [ScenarioDependencies] factory live at each TEST PROJECT ROOT, not in Core/Support, because Reqnroll discovers those attributes only in binding assemblies and a shared [Binding] hook would launch a browser for the API suite. Core/Support holds the plain implementation classes (WebDriverFactory, ScenarioDriver, FailureArtefacts, ScenarioCorrelation) and Core has NO runner reference. Scenario context classes also live at the owning test project root, because a context holding Refit contract records would force Core to reference Api and invert the dependency direction. Tests.Api registers NO driver and has NO hooks class; Tests.UI and Tests.E2E always start a driver, so there is no tag-driven conditional. Options classes are registered as concrete singletons (services.AddSingleton(webDriverOptions)), never IOptions<T>, and configuration is loaded inside the [ScenarioDependencies] factory with TestConfigurationLoader.Load(). Driver lifetime is one IWebDriver per scenario: started in [BeforeScenario(Order=10)], artefacts captured in [AfterScenario(Order=100)] inside a try when ScenarioContext.TestError != null, and ScenarioDriver.Quit() in the finally so a capture failure cannot leak a browser process. IWebDriver reaches page objects through services.AddScoped<IWebDriver>(provider => provider.GetRequiredService<ScenarioDriver>().Driver), which resolves lazily at the first step - after the hook has started the browser. Implicit wait stays at TimeSpan.Zero; every Until lambda in the repository is written once, inside ElementWaits. Page objects hold private static readonly By fields built from named consts, never cache an IWebElement, are synchronous, return the next page object on navigation, and never assert. Refit 16.3.0 MUST be registered with services.AddRefitGeneratedClient<T>() - AddRefitClient<T>() fails at run time demanding the extra Refit.Reflection package. Refit methods return IApiResponse<T>, never bare T, so 400 and 404 are inspected rather than thrown; response.Error is ApiExceptionBase and must be cast to ApiException to read .Content. API client wrappers return Contracts records that carry the status code and header values so steps never touch HttpResponseHeaders.
directory_structure: d:\git\QAAutomation\ root: Directory.Packages.props (all pins), Directory.Build.props (shared TFM and properties), Directory.Build.targets (no-LINQ warning), .editorconfig, .gitignore, QAAutomation.sln, README.md. src\QAAutomation.Core\ = Configuration (appsettings.json plus WebDriverOptions, ApiOptions, SiteOptions, ArtefactOptions, TestConfiguration, TestConfigurationLoader, TestConfigurationException), Support (WebDriverFactory, ScenarioDriver, FailureArtefacts, ScenarioCorrelation), Utilities (ElementWaits, TestIdLocator, HeaderValueReader, PositiveIntegerParser, FileNameSanitiser, UrlHostChecker, ArtefactPaths), plus CoreRegistration.cs; no project reference, no test runner. src\QAAutomation.UI\ = Pages (HomePage, LandedPage, ContactUsPage), Components (PrimaryNavigationComponent), UiRegistration.cs; references Core. src\QAAutomation.Api\ = Clients (IWordPressApi, PagesClient, RequestContextHandler), Contracts (RenderedText, WordPressPageResponse, WordPressErrorResponse, PageListResponse, PageLookupResponse), ApiRegistration.cs; references Core. tests\QAAutomation.Tests.UI\, tests\QAAutomation.Tests.Api\, tests\QAAutomation.Tests.E2E\ each hold Features\, Steps\, reqnroll.json, AssemblyInfo.cs, a *ScenarioDependencies.cs factory, their scenario context classes, and (UI and E2E only) WebDriverHooks.cs. test-results\ is runtime output, gitignored. There is deliberately NO pipelines\ folder - CI is parked by the user.

verified_target_system_facts.site: https://www.landmarksystems.co.uk/ - WordPress, Yoast SEO, W3 Total Cache + Redis. robots.txt disallows nothing. PRODUCTION AND READ-ONLY.
verified_target_system_facts.homepage_dom_title: Farm & Rural Estate Management Software | Landmark Systems (raw HTML carries &; the DOM title has a literal &)
verified_target_system_facts.never_assert_on: The rotating hero carousel, the animated odometer statistic counters, and any <h1> on the homepage (there are four, one per carousel slide).
verified_target_system_facts.homepage_nav: TWO <nav class="site-header__navigation"> elements exist (desktop and mobile copies). Only one is Displayed at 1920x1080, so always resolve the first visible match - a bare FindElement can click a hidden link and throw ElementNotInteractableException.
verified_target_system_facts.nav_link_names: About Us -> /about-us/, Support -> /support/, Landmark HUB -> /landmark-hub/, Our Products -> submenu (href=#empty), and the contact link is labelled 'Contact Sales' -> /contact-us/ (NOT 'Contact Us').
verified_target_system_facts.contact_form: Gravity Forms: <form id='gform_2' action='/contact-us/#gf_2' novalidate> submitting by AJAX iframe. novalidate means there is NO client-side validation at all - the only validation is server-side behind a POST. Fields carry deterministic ids input_<formId>_<fieldId>: input_2_4 Company Name (optional), input_2_5 First Name*, input_2_19 Surname*, input_2_6 Postcode*, input_2_7 Email address*, input_2_8 Telephone*, input_2_9 Mobile (optional), input_2_10 Your Enquiry (optional). The five starred fields carry aria-required="true"; the optional ones do not.
verified_target_system_facts.api_verified: GET /pages?per_page=2&_fields=id,slug,title,link -> 200, X-WP-Total: 18, X-WP-TotalPages: 9, title is {"rendered":"..."}. GET /pages?per_page=0 -> 400 rest_invalid_param. GET /pages?per_page=101 -> 400 rest_invalid_param ('per_page must be between 1 (inclusive) and 100 (inclusive)'). GET /pages/1785 -> 200, slug 'technical', title.rendered 'Technical', link https://www.landmarksystems.co.uk/technical/. GET /pages/999999 -> 404. per_page is a verified boundary: valid 1-100 inclusive, invalid at 0 and 101.
verified_target_system_facts.cross_layer_title_rule: The browser title for /technical/ is 'Technical - Landmark minimum recommended hardware requirements | Landmark Systems'. So the API's title.rendered is a case-insensitive SUBSTRING of the browser title, never equal - titles are SEO titles with no uniform suffix.
verified_target_system_facts.three_rules_that_must_be_obeyed: 1. NEVER hard-assert 18 or any live content count - X-WP-Total changes when Landmark publishes a page. Assert the header EXISTS, parses to a POSITIVE INTEGER, and that the returned item count is <= per_page, with a comment explaining why. This is the most important lesson the template teaches. 2. NEVER assert on rotating or animated content - page title, stable headings, navigation and form field metadata only. 3. PRODUCTION SITE, READ-ONLY: never submit the contact form. ContactUsPage must have NO submit method at all, and both the feature file and the page object must carry an explicit comment saying so, so nobody 'finishes' it later.
verified_target_system_facts.locator_exception: ui-automation-selenium.md mandates data-testid-first. A third-party WordPress site has none and we cannot add any, so this template uses the most stable selectors actually available (nav.site-header__navigation scoped to the first visible match, Gravity Forms' deterministic input_2_* ids, href-based nav links). This is a DELIBERATE DOCUMENTED exception: state the reason in a comment at the top of EVERY page object and in the README, prefer stable semantic selectors over deep structural CSS, and justify any XPath inline. TestIdLocator still ships, unused and commented, because data-testid becomes primary again on KEYinfinity.

already_verified_do_not_repeat: A throwaway spike on this machine already proved: the whole 16-package set restores and builds on net10.0 under central package management with transitive pinning; dotnet test discovers and passes Reqnroll scenarios; headless Chrome works with no driver package; an instance [Binding] hook with a constructor-injected scoped service shares that instance with step classes; AddScoped<IWebDriver>(provider => ...ScenarioDriver.Driver) resolves lazily at the first step; ChromeOptions.SetLoggingPreference(LogType.Browser, LogLevel.All) makes driver.Manage().Logs.GetLog(LogType.Browser) return entries; --filter "TestCategory=smoke" works because Reqnroll emits [Category] per tag; AddRefitClient<T>() FAILS at run time and AddRefitGeneratedClient<T>() works; IApiResponse<T> returns 200/400/404 without throwing and exposes Headers; and the Directory.Build.targets findstr target warns on an offending file while the build still succeeds with 0 errors. Do not re-spike these.
